_about: Declarative registry of every source design-canon draws from.
watch    checked on every scheduled run for items not yet in the skill (incremental)
seed     bulk corpus, refreshed only on demand with `discover.py --seed`
roadmap  deliberately NOT ingested yet; kept here so the decision is documented in code
green  openly licensed. Distill freely with attribution; informational assets may be mirrored.
amber  free to read, all rights reserved. Distill the idea in your own words, link the source,
never reproduce prose verbatim, never mirror images.
red    the content IS the product being sold. Excluded until the publisher grants permission.
html-index  fetch `index`, keep every href matching `item_pattern`
rss         fetch `index` as RSS/Atom, read <item>/<entry> links
single      `index` is itself the one item to distill
theme: the references/<theme>.md file a distilled entry from this source lands in.
